correctness.rationale: Necessity follows from the cited general complete-palindromic-return characterization. The special two-occurrence constraint forces any first return to one of two exhausted-letter prefixes: nested rainbow or abab; induction yields a unique disjoint-block parse. Direct palindrome-factor counting then establishes sufficiency, and the bivariate generating function follows by an unambiguous sequence construction with exactly one crossing per abab block. Checked boundaries q=1,2 and coefficients; an independently implemented exhaustive direct palindrome and endpoint crossing test passed all 146599 canonical DOW for 1<=q<=7, without relying on finite observations as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: A complete natural classification of palindrome-rich Gauss/double-occurrence words by two explicit irreducible building blocks; exact refined enumerator simultaneously tracks alphabet size and all interlacement counts, and yields the sharp noncrossing subclass and irreducible census. The result distinguishes ordinary factor-richness from weaker returns and reverse-symmetric DOW notions, structurally connecting word palindromes with matching-diagram crossing statistics. This has mathematical content beyond merely reproducing the known univariate integer sequence.
